An L-shape with one vertical and one horizontal arm has:
- Bbox area = (height) × (width)


- Cells = (height_arm - 1) + (width_arm - 1) + 1 = height + width - 1

Testing with height=6, width=7: cells = 12, bbox area = 42, ratio = 3.5. This applies to any L-shape where one segment is a straight edge. The ratio would be smaller for more compact, filled L-shapes, but uncoupled arms still produce high ratios.
